description: Create inbound email deliverability audits and retrieve MailGenius test results.

auth.label: API Token
auth.description: MailGenius API token sent with the Authorization Bearer header. Create and manage API tokens in the MailGenius application: https://app.mailgenius.com/.

actions.name: create_email_audit
actions.description: Generate a MailGenius test email address for an inbound deliverability audit.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for generating a MailGenius test email.

audit.description: A JSON object returned by MailGenius.

outputSchema.description: The wrapped generated test email response.

actions.name: get_daily_limit
actions.description: Get the MailGenius API token daily test limit, used count, and remaining count.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for fetching the MailGenius daily limit.

dailyLimit.description: A JSON object returned by MailGenius.

outputSchema.description: The wrapped MailGenius daily limit response.

actions.name: get_email_result
actions.description: Get the MailGenius result for a generated test email slug, including NOT_READY responses before analysis is complete.

slug.description: The MailGenius test email slug returned by create_email_audit or list_email_audits.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for fetching a MailGenius email test result.

result.description: A JSON object returned by MailGenius.

outputSchema.description: The wrapped MailGenius email test result response.

actions.name: list_email_audits
actions.description: List MailGenius generated test emails and their slugs, optionally filtered by time range and used state.

page.description: The one-based result page to fetch.

perPage.description: The maximum number of audit items to return.

used.description: Whether to return used or unused test email audit items.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for listing MailGenius test email audit items.

slug.description: The MailGenius slug used to fetch this test email result.

test_email.description: The generated MailGenius test email address.

items.description: A MailGenius test email audit item.

testEmails.description: The test email audit items returned by MailGenius.

raw.description: A JSON object returned by MailGenius.

outputSchema.description: The wrapped MailGenius test email list response.
